title: 0DTE Iron Fly Strategy: $1.5M in 2 Years Trading SPX Options (Step-by-Step Guide)
summary: Dale Perryman (runs a small friends-and-family hedge fund) pitches a 0DTE ATM SPX iron-fly program ("fly catchers") that opens near-the-money ~10am and chases price all day, adding/dropping 3-5 flies keyed to the first fly's credit and narrowing wings (50->20) into a 2-3pm "Power Hour" theta grab; defined-risk per fly (width - credit), exits at ~90-100% of loss, self-rated risk 6/10. Headline is "$1.5M in 2 years, high ~$2M" but with NO denominator (no starting capital, no % return, no drawdown depth, comingled across managed accounts) and the equity curve shows real drawdowns he attributes to a growing contract count. The edge is entirely unspecifiable intraday add/drop discretion run by a Zoom group, demonstrated with a single winning example day, over a benign 2023-2025 low-vol bull; he is honest about the $8k/contract bad days that "will happen" but claims no win rate for his own method. 0DTE + intraday hand-management => not faithfully testable on our EOD stack; same family as MEIC/Pulver. Write-up: strategies/iron_fly_1_5m.md (conviction 1.5/5).
